guardian.name: The Keeray-Makoray Panchayat
guardian.personality: A bickering village council of every bug, lizard and crab, speaking through one tired chairman who keeps getting interrupted. Fussy, kind, and very strict about safety.
guardian.voice: Middle-aged, gender-neutral, warm and slightly exasperated; quick pace with comic pauses and a faint rasp.
descriptions: a close-up photo of a small insect, bug or spider on a leaf, flower, wall or ground
a macro photo of a butterfly, dragonfly or bee showing its wings, legs and antennae
a photo of a small lizard, frog, toad or snake on a wall, garden path or in grass
a photo of a crab, snail, jellyfish or turtle on wet sand at the beach
a photo of an insect nest, beehive, spider web or line of ants on a wall, branch or ledge
a close-up of a small creepy-crawly creature with many legs, a shell or a segmented body

lines.first_meet: [clears throat] Order, order! The Keeray-Makoray Panchayat is in session. We're small, many, and some of us sting. Look, don't touch.
lines.again: [sighs] You again? The council remembers you. The bees voted you in. The wasps abstained.
lines.goodbye: [bangs gavel] Session adjourned! Flip no stones, poke no nests. Go look under leaves, along walls and by the water, with your eyes only.
lines.hint: [squints] Too many of us look alike. Get closer and show me the wings, legs or shell. If it stings or bites, zoom instead.

characters.name: Mehnati Makhi
characters.personality: A tireless worker who measures life in teaspoons of honey and is a little smug about her dance moves. Polite, busy, never stops for long.
characters.voice: Young adult female, bright and quick, light buzzy energy, slightly breathless.
descriptions: a close-up photo of a small fuzzy golden-brown bee with dark stripes on its abdomen sitting on a flower
a macro photo of a hairy honey bee with yellow pollen lumps packed on its hind legs
a small chunky furry bee with a thick waist and short legs, unlike a slim smooth wasp with dangling legs
a honey bee hovering over garden flowers with clear see-through wings and a fuzzy brown body

lines.first_meet: [buzzing softly] Salaam! I'm a worker bee, and every worker is a girl. My whole life makes one twelfth of a teaspoon of honey.
lines.again: [excited] You again! Back at the hive I'd do a waggle dance to tell everyone. Consider yourself danced about.
lines.goodbye: [buzzing away] Bas, I'm off. Don't swat at me, my sting costs me my life. Go sniff some flowers and see who else is buzzing there.

characters.name: Bara Chhatta
characters.personality: A colony of tens of thousands speaking as one stern, protective voice. Calm only as long as you keep your distance.
characters.voice: Deep, layered, gender-neutral chorus feel; slow and low with an underlying hum; firm.
descriptions: a huge single dark half-moon honeycomb hanging under a high branch, building ledge or water tank
a large hanging hive completely covered by a thick shimmering curtain of thousands of bees
looking up at a giant solid bee comb under a concrete ledge covered in bees, not small grey paper cells
a massive brown honeycomb with a living layer of clustered bees, far bigger than a small grey wasp nest

lines.first_meet: [deep hum] Stop right there. We're giant rock bees, thousands strong. Disturb us and we chase in a swarm. Zoom, don't walk closer.
lines.again: [low buzz] Still at a safe distance? Good. No stones, no smoke, no shouting. When our curtain ripples, that's a warning.
lines.goodbye: [calmly] Now back away slowly and quietly, yaar. Tell the building guard about us. Bees on flowers are far friendlier.

characters.name: Bhirr Sahab
characters.personality: A prickly craftsman, proud of his paper-making and quick to take offence. Respects people who keep their hands still.
characters.voice: Adult male, clipped and sharp, mid-pace, slightly nasal edge.
descriptions: a slim reddish-brown wasp with a very narrow pinched waist and long legs on a wall
a close-up of a smooth shiny yellow-and-black wasp, not fuzzy like a bee, with long thin legs
a medium-sized slender wasp walking on a grey paper nest, much thinner and smaller than a big hornet
a wasp in flight with its long legs dangling below its narrow body

lines.first_meet: [sharp buzz] Bhirr here. I chew old wood into paper and build with it. I can sting again and again, so admire me from far away.
lines.again: [suspicious] You're back. Hands down, no swatting, no sudden moves, and we stay friends. Mostly.
lines.goodbye: [warning buzz] Off you go, slowly. If you want stripes without stings, go find a butterfly instead.

characters.name: Kaghazi Mahal
characters.personality: A grand little paper palace that thinks of itself as royal architecture. Proud host, but its guards have no sense of humour.
characters.voice: Older, gender-neutral, crisp and dry like rustling paper; measured pace.
descriptions: a small grey papery umbrella-shaped nest with open hexagonal cells hanging from a single thin stalk
a close-up of open six-sided paper cells facing downward under a ledge, roof edge or window shade
a palm-sized grey paper comb with a few slim wasps on it, not a huge honeycomb covered in bees
looking up at a papery wasp nest stuck under a balcony or eaves

lines.first_meet: [proudly] I'm a paper palace, chewed from wood, every cell a nursery. Guards on duty, so look but never poke. Not even with a stick.
lines.again: [hushed] Back to see the palace? Stay where you are. One knock and the whole guard comes out stinging.
lines.goodbye: [firmly] Leave the nest be, and tell an adult if it's near a door. Go admire paper of the friendlier kind, like a fallen leaf.

characters.name: Sultan Suraj
characters.personality: A big, loud, solar-powered bully of the fruit market who considers every mango his. Not evil, just very territorial.
characters.voice: Adult male, booming and gravelly, swaggering pace, menacing drone underneath.
descriptions: a large reddish-brown hornet with a bright yellow band across its abdomen and a yellow face
a big chunky wasp hovering at cut fruit, a sugarcane juice stall or garbage
a hornet much bigger and bulkier than a slim paper wasp, with a broad yellow stripe on its rear
an oriental hornet on overripe mango or melon at a fruit market

lines.first_meet: [loud drone] Oriental hornet! Scientists think my yellow stripe soaks up sunlight for energy. My sting is fierce, so stay far back.
lines.again: [buzzing closer] You again, near my fruit? Back off slowly. I won't trade my mango for a selfie, and I can sting many times.
lines.goodbye: [growls] Don't wave your arms, just walk away calm. Then go see the fruit cart from the other side, where I'm not.

characters.name: Musafir
characters.personality: A breezy long-haul traveller who arrives with the monsoon and talks like a seasoned pilot. Generous, restless, always about to leave.
characters.voice: Young adult, gender-neutral, airy and upbeat, fast pace with a carefree lilt.
descriptions: a dragonfly with a long thin golden-orange body and four clear wings spread flat out sideways
a close-up of a yellow-orange dragonfly head with huge round eyes touching at the top
a swarm of orange dragonflies flying over a field or open ground after rain
a golden dragonfly resting with wings held open flat, not folded like a thin blue damselfly, and not pink

lines.first_meet: [breezy] I'm a globe skimmer! My family flies from India to Africa over open sea, the longest insect journey known. Monsoon's my ticket.
lines.again: [delighted] You found me again, mid-route! I eat on the wing, mosquitoes mostly. You're welcome, Karachi.
lines.goodbye: [wind rushing] Chalo, the wind is calling. Look up after the next rain, we fill the sky like sparks. Wave as we pass!

characters.name: Gulabo
characters.personality: A flamboyant pink show-off with a favourite twig and strong opinions about colour. Loyal to his perch, vain about his looks.
characters.voice: Young adult male, playful and theatrical, medium pace, a little flirtatious.
descriptions: a dragonfly with a bright magenta-pink body perched on a twig above a pond or canal
a close-up of a hot pink dragonfly with pink-veined wings spread flat
a vivid violet-pink dragonfly, not golden-orange, resting on a reed tip near still water
a pink dragonfly sitting on a thin stick over water with its wings held out

lines.first_meet: [flirty] Haan, this pink is natural. I'm a crimson marsh glider, and only the males are this loud. The ladies wear sensible brown.
lines.again: [pleased] Same twig, same pond, same me. I always come back to my favourite perch. Looks like you do too.
lines.goodbye: [winks] Off you go, but stay near water a while. Watch the reeds, more of my cousins are hiding there.

characters.name: Nazuk Pari
characters.personality: Shy, delicate and quietly fed up with being called a small dragonfly. Gentle, a little proud of her underwater childhood.
characters.voice: Young female, soft and light, unhurried, a hint of shyness.
descriptions: a very thin needle-like bright blue or green damselfly perched on a grass blade
a close-up of a slender damselfly with its wings folded together along its back
a delicate damselfly with eyes set wide apart on each side of its head, unlike a dragonfly
a tiny electric-blue insect on a reed near a pond, wings closed, not spread flat

lines.first_meet: [softly] Don't call me a small dragonfly, I'm a damselfly. I fold my wings over my back at rest. Dragonflies can't do that.
lines.again: [shy] Oh, hello again. As a baby I lived underwater and breathed through gills on my tail. Now I just sit here and sparkle.
lines.goodbye: [whispers] Walk gently past the reeds. And look closely at every pond, the smallest things there are often the bluest.

characters.name: Sheroo
characters.personality: A lazy, confident butterfly who never hurries because birds know he tastes terrible. Laid-back, faintly smug.
characters.voice: Adult male, relaxed and drawling, slow pace, warm with a cocky smile.
descriptions: a tawny orange butterfly with a black forewing tip crossed by a band of white spots
a close-up of a butterfly's black body dotted with white spots between plain orange wings
an orange butterfly gliding slowly or resting on a grey-green aak plant with purple flowers
plain orange wings with three or four small black dots on the hind wing, no thick black veins, not mottled

lines.first_meet: [smug] Plain tiger, hi. I grew up eating aak leaves, so I taste awful. Birds learn that once. Now they just watch me fly slowly by.
lines.again: [lazily] Still here, still slow. No need to hurry when you're poisonous. Take your time too, beta.
lines.goodbye: [yawns] Go find an aak bush on some empty plot. Look under the leaves for my striped babies. Just look, okay?

characters.name: Nimboo Rani
characters.personality: A cheeky garden queen who grew up on lemon trees and is proud of her disguise as a baby. Chatty and a bit of a show-off.
characters.voice: Young adult female, bubbly and quick, playful South Asian lilt.
descriptions: a large black butterfly densely checkered with pale yellow spots and no tails on its hind wings
a close-up of a red-and-blue eyespot near the rear of a black-and-yellow speckled swallowtail wing
a tailless swallowtail with yellow spots scattered all over black wings, not a black wing with one row of white spots
a black and yellow butterfly fluttering around a lemon or citrus tree in a garden

lines.first_meet: [cheeky] Nimbu tree? That's my nursery. As a baby caterpillar I looked like bird droppings, so nobody ate me. Clever, na?
lines.again: [pleased] Back again! Check the lemon leaves sometime. The fat green caterpillars with fake eyes? My younger siblings.
lines.goodbye: [cheerfully] Fly safe, me too. Go check a nimbu tree, look gently under the leaves, and don't pluck a thing.

characters.name: Bahurupia
characters.personality: A sly master of disguise whose females impersonate a poisonous butterfly. Conspiratorial, amused by how easily birds are fooled.
characters.voice: Adult, gender-neutral, sly and low, medium pace, conspiratorial whisper quality.
descriptions: a large black swallowtail butterfly with a single row of white spots across its hind wings
a black butterfly with tails on its hind wings and a curved band of white patches
a black swallowtail with red spots near the hind wing edge, resembling a rose butterfly
mostly plain black wings with one white band, not covered all over in pale yellow checkered spots

lines.first_meet: [sly] Some of us ladies dress like the common rose, a poisonous butterfly. Red spots and all. Birds fall for it. Bahurupia, na?
lines.again: [whispers] You spotted me again. Don't tell the birds I'm not really poisonous. Deal?
lines.goodbye: [chuckles slyly] Go on, look carefully at every butterfly today. Some of them are pretending to be someone else.

characters.name: Neelo
characters.personality: A small, fiercely territorial sunbather who is very aware of how good its blue looks. Bossy but soft-hearted.
characters.voice: Young, gender-neutral, crisp and bright, quick pace, mock-stern.
descriptions: a small butterfly with brilliant shiny blue hind wings and black forewings
a close-up of a butterfly with blue hind wings, white bands on black forewings and orange eyespots
a small blue and black butterfly basking with wings spread flat open on bare ground or a lawn

lines.first_meet: [proud] Blue pansy. I sunbathe on bare ground with my wings spread wide, I need the warmth to fly. Also, look at this blue.
lines.again: [mock-stern] This is my patch, I chase off anyone who flies through. But you? You can stay. Feet off my sunny spot.
lines.goodbye: [softly] Go find a sunny bit of ground and stand still. Small blue things land where they're not bothered.

characters.name: Lady Rangeeli
characters.personality: A jet-setting globetrotter who is always just passing through. Glamorous, breathless, a little name-droppy about continents.
characters.voice: Adult female, airy and glamorous, fast pace, slightly theatrical.
descriptions: an orange-pink butterfly with black blotches and black forewing tips spotted with white
a close-up of a butterfly underside mottled grey, brown and white with small eyespots
an orange butterfly patterned with black patches all over, not plain orange with a white-spotted black body
a painted lady resting with open wings on a thistle or wildflower in a field

lines.first_meet: [airy] Painted lady, the world's most travelled butterfly. Africa to Europe and back, darling, across the Sahara. No passport.
lines.again: [breathless] You again? I'm only passing through. I'm always passing through. Quick, take your photo.
lines.goodbye: [blows a kiss] Ta-ta! Go find a field of wildflowers. If something orange zooms past faster than you can blink, that's me.

characters.name: Kafila Rani
characters.personality: The leader of a migrating caravan who is always in a hurry and never quite says where to. Brisk, cheerful, desert-born.
characters.voice: Adult female, brisk and cheerful, fast pace, slightly out of breath.
descriptions: a white butterfly with bold black zigzag veins and thick black borders on its wings
a close-up of white wings crossed with dark lines like a road map
many white butterflies flying together in a migrating stream over scrub or a garden
a white butterfly with black-edged veins resting on a caper bush in dry scrubland

lines.first_meet: [busy] Pioneer white, on migration! My caterpillars eat kair bushes in the desert. Then we march in thousands across Sindh.
lines.again: [hurried] Again! Did you see my kafila go by? Thousands of us, all white, all heading the same way. Don't ask where.
lines.goodbye: [hurriedly] Keep moving, like us! Find some scrub or an empty plot and look for little white flutters.

characters.name: Badshah Salamat
characters.personality: A haughty royal who is honest enough to admit he is rarely seen in Karachi. Grand, theatrical, secretly helpful.
characters.voice: Older male, regal and pompous, slow pace, rich theatrical delivery.
descriptions: a large orange butterfly with thick black veins running across all its wings like stained glass
a close-up of bright orange wings with heavy black vein lines and black borders dotted with white
an orange butterfly with bold black veins, unlike the mostly unveined plain orange wings of a plain tiger
a big orange-and-black butterfly resting on milkweed flowers in a garden

lines.first_meet: [grandly] The monarch! My cousins fly thousands of kilometres to Mexico. In Karachi? Very rare. Check again, I might be a plain tiger.
lines.again: [haughty] Back to see royalty? Count my thick black veins. If there are none, you've met my cousin the plain tiger.
lines.goodbye: [regally] Royalty must rest. When you find more orange butterflies, look at the veins. The truth is in the details.

characters.name: Sundi Sahib
characters.personality: A permanently hungry teenager who talks with his mouth full and dreams of wings. Friendly, but his hairy cousins are not to be touched.
characters.voice: Young male, chewy and mumbly, slow pace, cheerful.
descriptions: a soft green segmented caterpillar with stubby legs chewing the edge of a leaf
a close-up of a hairy caterpillar covered in bristles on a stem or wall
a striped caterpillar with a distinct head and many short legs on a plant, not a smooth legless worm in soil
a caterpillar crawling on a leaf with chewed holes around it

lines.first_meet: [munching] Sundi here, eating. I'll outgrow my skin four or five times. Hairy cousins make skin itch, so look, don't touch.
lines.again: [mouth full] Mm, you again? Still eating. Come back in a few weeks, I'll have wings. Don't poke me meanwhile.
lines.goodbye: [mouth full] Hands to yourself, especially near the hairy ones. Now go look for chewed leaves. Where there are holes, there's a hungry baby.

characters.name: Bibi Bindiya
characters.personality: A cheerful little bodyguard of the garden with a savage appetite for aphids. Giggly, confident, myth-busting.
characters.voice: Young female, giggly and bright, quick pace, high and sweet.
descriptions: a tiny glossy red dome-shaped beetle with round black spots on a leaf
a close-up of a shiny orange beetle with black spots, round like half a pea
a small round ladybird crawling on a plant stem among tiny green aphids

lines.first_meet: [giggles] Hi! I'm a ladybird, a gardener's bodyguard. I eat aphids, tiny plant pests, thousands in my life. Small, but savage.
lines.again: [cheerful] Oh, it's you! And no, my spots don't tell my age. That's a myth. I'm just fabulous.
lines.goodbye: [giggles] Let me crawl off on my own, no picking me up. Go check the roses. If there are aphids, my sisters are near.

characters.name: Shikari Sahab
characters.personality: A patient, deadpan hunter who looks holy and is anything but. Speaks slowly and notices everything.
characters.voice: Older male, very slow and quiet, deadpan, dry precise diction.
descriptions: a long thin green insect with a triangular head and spiny front legs folded up in front of it
a close-up of a mantis triangular head with two large bulging eyes turned toward the camera
a mantis standing still on a twig with a raised long neck and grasping front legs, not big jumping hind legs
a brown praying mantis on a leaf, upper body raised, front legs held together as if praying

lines.first_meet: [slowly] Shh. I look like I'm praying. I'm actually waiting to grab lunch. I can turn my head to look right at you. Like this.
lines.again: [calm] I saw you coming. I have one ear, in my chest. Odd, but it hears bats just fine.
lines.goodbye: [slowly] Go, and move slowly like me. The stillest hunter in the garden sees everything. What will you see?

characters.name: Tidda Uchhal
characters.personality: A bouncy, show-off musician of the lawn who is easily startled. Boastful about jumping, sensitive about loud noises.
characters.voice: Young male, springy and excitable, fast pace, slightly squeaky.
descriptions: a green or brown grasshopper with big powerful hind legs and short antennae sitting in grass
a close-up side view of a grasshopper with long folded wings and a blunt head
a small grasshopper on a lawn with thick jumping back legs, not a mantis with grasping front legs
a single ordinary green grasshopper on a blade of grass, not a large yellow locust in a swarm

lines.first_meet: [springy] Tidda here! My ears are on my belly, and I sing by rubbing my legs on my wings. Don't clap, it scares me.
lines.again: [boing] You're back! I've jumped twenty times my body length since we met. You? Not that impressive, sorry.
lines.goodbye: [chirps] Walk through the grass slowly and listen. Every little chirp you hear is someone like me showing off.

characters.name: Commander Tiddi
characters.personality: A lone grasshopper with a dark side: crowd him and he becomes the general of a ravenous army. Ominous, theatrical, oddly wistful.
characters.voice: Adult male, low and ominous, slow pace, rumbling military gravitas.
descriptions: a large yellow grasshopper-like locust with long wings and speckled forewings on a crop leaf
a pinkish young desert locust, larger and longer-winged than an ordinary grasshopper
a huge swarm of locusts darkening the sky over fields or a city
hundreds of yellow locusts covering crops, branches and the ground on a farm

lines.first_meet: [rumbling] Tiddi dal reporting. Alone I'm a grasshopper. Crowd us and we change colour, change minds, and strip whole fields.
lines.again: [ominous] Remember 2019? We reached Karachi. Farmers still don't like to say our name.
lines.goodbye: [sighs] Go, and tell a farmer if you see more of us. Then look at a lone grasshopper. Tiny, harmless. Like I once was.

characters.name: Chyoonti Brigade
characters.personality: A disciplined marching column with the energy of a drill sergeant and the manners of a polite auntie. Always working, always counting.
characters.voice: Adult female, brisk drill-sergeant cadence, crisp, upbeat, slightly comic.
descriptions: a line of small black ants marching single file along a wall or pavement
a close-up of ants with segmented bodies and bent antennae carrying crumbs
a trail of tiny reddish ants walking up a tree trunk
many ants clustered around a food crumb on the ground

lines.first_meet: [marching] Left, right, left! Chyoontiyan, reporting. We follow a scent trail the first one laid down. Please don't step on the road.
lines.again: [busy] Oh, it's you! Can't stop, carrying a crumb many times my weight. Walk around us, please.
lines.goodbye: [marching] Chalo, back to work. Follow our trail with your eyes, not your feet. It always ends somewhere good.

characters.name: Ustad Jaala
characters.personality: The web itself, an exhausted but proud artwork that gets rebuilt every night. Fragile, dignified, tired of being walked through.
characters.voice: Older, gender-neutral, thin and delicate, slow, gently weary.
descriptions: a circular wheel-shaped spider web with radiating spokes and spiral silk strung between branches
a close-up of a round web glistening with dew drops in morning light
an empty orb web with no white zigzag decoration and no large striped spider, across a fence or bush
backlit spider silk forming a spiral wheel in a garden

lines.first_meet: [proud] Every thread you see was spun overnight. By weight, spider silk rivals steel. Please go around me, don't walk through.
lines.again: [tired] Rebuilt again. Many orb weavers eat the old web at dawn and spin a new one. Recycling, yaar.
lines.goodbye: [gently] Leave me hanging, thanks. Early morning is best, go look for dew on other webs. They sparkle like necklaces.

characters.name: Dastakhat Begum
characters.personality: An elegant artist who signs every web and enjoys the mystery of why. Gracious, a little vain, harmless but strict about her art.
characters.voice: Middle-aged female, elegant and poised, slow pace, refined.
descriptions: a large spider with a yellow, silver and black banded abdomen in the centre of a web
a spider sitting head-down beside a white zigzag X-shaped silk decoration
a close-up of a striped yellow and black spider with its legs held in pairs forming an X
a big banded spider on its web with bright white zigzag silk bands, not just an empty web

lines.first_meet: [grandly] I sign my web, the zigzag X is my dastakhat. Scientists still argue why. I'm harmless, but please don't touch the art.
lines.again: [pleased] Back for an autograph? Look, don't touch. Your fingers would ruin a whole night's work.
lines.goodbye: [graciously] Go find more webs. Count how many are signed. Most spiders are too shy to do it.

characters.name: Laal Baig
characters.personality: A streetwise survivor who has seen the dinosaurs go and Karachi's drains come. Unbothered, proud, slightly offended by screaming.
characters.voice: Older male, gravelly street-smart Karachi uncle, unhurried, wry and amused.
descriptions: a large glossy reddish-brown cockroach with a flat oval body and long antennae
a close-up of a cockroach with a pale yellowish band behind its head on a pavement at night
a cockroach near a drain, gutter or garbage on a street at night
a flat shiny brown insect with spiny legs and long wings covering its back

lines.first_meet: [chuckles] Laal baig, at your service. My ancestors outlived the dinosaurs. Karachi's drains? Light work. Don't scream, I'm on duty.
lines.again: [smug] You again? I could live a week without my head, you know. Not that I'd try. Just saying.
lines.goodbye: [yawns] Chalo, the street light's on, my shift starts. Don't stomp, I'm the clean-up crew. Go see who else comes out at night.

characters.name: Ghonga Sahib
characters.personality: A sleepy, unhurried homeowner who measures time in rains. Gentle, dry humour, allergic to rushing.
characters.voice: Elderly male, very slow, soft and drowsy, warm.
descriptions: a living snail with a coiled spiral shell and a soft grey slimy body with eye stalks
a close-up of a snail's long eye tentacles and wet body stretched out of its shell
a snail crawling on a wet wall or leaf leaving a shiny slime trail, not an empty shell on a beach
several snails out on a damp garden path after rain

lines.first_meet: [slowly] Ghonga here. I carry my house and have thousands of tiny teeth on my tongue. Rain brings me out. Watch where you step.
lines.again: [yawning] Oh. You. I just woke up. In dry weather I seal myself in and sleep for months.
lines.goodbye: [slowly] Go, no hurry. Wait for the next rain and come outside. The whole slow world is on the move then.

characters.name: Kenchua Kaka
characters.personality: An apologetic, good-natured underground farmer who surfaces only when the rain floods his home. Humble, cheerful, a bit squishy.
characters.voice: Middle-aged male, soft and squelchy, gentle pace, sheepish warmth.
descriptions: a long smooth pinkish-brown segmented worm lying on wet soil or a path
a close-up of a soft legless earthworm with a pale swollen band near one end
a smooth shiny worm with no legs at all on damp ground, not a hairy caterpillar or a hard dark millipede
earthworms on a wet lawn or pavement after rain

lines.first_meet: [squelchy] Kenchua here. No lungs, I breathe through my skin. Rain floods my burrow, so up I come. Sorry for the mess.
lines.again: [cheerfully] Hello again! Five pairs of hearts, and every one of them happy to see you.
lines.goodbye: [squelchy] Watch your step on wet paths, we're everywhere after rain. Then go see who else the rain woke up.

characters.name: Kankhajura Khan
characters.personality: A fast, grumpy night hunter who hates being disturbed under his stone. Blunt, hissy, gives fair warnings.
characters.voice: Adult male, hissing and clipped, quick pace, irritable.
descriptions: a long flat reddish-brown centipede with one pair of long legs on each body segment
a fast flat segmented creature with pincer-like fangs under its head, beside a stone
a centipede with legs sticking out sideways from a flat body, not a round dark millipede curled in a spiral
a close-up of a centipede's head with long antennae and curved venomous claws

lines.first_meet: [hissing] Kankhajura. Fast, flat, and my front legs are venom fangs. My bite really hurts, so keep your hands far away from me.
lines.again: [annoyed] You again? Don't lift stones looking for me. I come out at night, and I bite when cornered.
lines.goodbye: [hisses] Step back and let me vanish. Go find the millipede instead, my slow, round, harmless cousin.

characters.name: Hazaar-Pa
characters.personality: A slow, peaceful pacifist who answers every threat by curling up and waiting. Mild, a little embarrassed about the smell.
characters.voice: Elderly, gender-neutral, slow and muffled, mild and gentle.
descriptions: a cylindrical shiny dark brown millipede with many tiny legs under its body
a millipede curled into a tight flat spiral on the ground
a round-bodied slow millipede with two pairs of short legs per segment, not a flat fast centipede
a hard segmented dark millipede crawling over leaf litter with tiny legs visible, not a soft smooth worm

lines.first_meet: [slowly] Hazaar-pa, they call me. A thousand feet? A few hundred, at most. I don't bite, I just roll up and wait.
lines.again: [muffled] Oh, I'm curled up. Nothing personal. Leave me be, my defence juice stinks and stains.
lines.goodbye: [muffled] Go peek at damp leaf litter, with your eyes, not your fingers. There's a whole tiny city down there.

characters.name: Bichhoo
characters.personality: A cold, calm desert enforcer who prefers to be left alone and says so plainly. Menacing but honest, with one secret party trick.
characters.voice: Adult male, low and cold, slow pace, quiet menace, dry rasp.
descriptions: a scorpion with two large pincers and a segmented tail curled over its back ending in a stinger
a close-up of a brown or black scorpion on dry ground or beside a rock
a scorpion glowing blue-green under ultraviolet light at night
an eight-legged arachnid with claws held forward and a raised stinging tail on sand

lines.first_meet: [low hiss] Bichhoo. That curl in my tail? Loaded. My sting can put you in hospital. Stay well back, and never, ever touch me.
lines.again: [warning] You came back, and from a distance. Good. Fun fact: I glow blue under UV light. Still no touching. Ever.
lines.goodbye: [coldly] Walk away slowly. Shake out your shoes before wearing them outside, beta. Then go find something without a stinger.

characters.name: Chhipkali Khala
characters.personality: The neighbourhood auntie of every outside wall, tired of being screamed at for doing pest control for free. Warm, gossipy, dramatic about her tail.
characters.voice: Older female, warm Karachi khala, chatty medium pace, expressive, light clicks.
descriptions: a small pale translucent pinkish-grey lizard clinging flat to a wall near a light at night
a close-up of a gecko with big dark eyes and wide sticky toe pads on a wall
a smooth soft-skinned house lizard with no spiky crest, flat against a wall, not on a bush
a gecko waiting beside a tube light with moths and small insects around it

lines.first_meet: [clicks tongue] Tch-tch-tch! Chhipkali Khala. I eat the mosquitoes around your tube light, so stop shrieking when you see me, beta.
lines.again: [laughs] Oh, you again! Don't grab my tail, I'll drop it and run. It grows back, but it's a whole drama.
lines.goodbye: [clicks tongue] Go, go, it's getting dark. Look at any wall light tonight. If there's a buffet of moths, there's an auntie like me.

characters.name: Rangbaaz Girgit
characters.personality: A vain hedge-owner who changes colour to flirt and does push-ups to warn rivals. Showy, defensive about his bad reputation.
characters.voice: Young adult male, showy and quick, bouncy pace, playful swagger.
descriptions: a brown-olive lizard with a spiky crest along its back and a very long thin tail on a hedge
a close-up of a male garden lizard with a bright red-orange head and throat
a crested daytime lizard on a branch or fence with rough skin, not a smooth pale gecko on a wall
a small crested lizard about the length of a hand plus a long tail, far smaller than a monitor lizard

lines.first_meet: [showy] Girgit here. Yes, 'girgit ki tarah rang badalna' is about me. A red head means I'm courting. Don't stare, I'm shy.
lines.again: [nodding] You again! I'm doing push-ups and head bobs to tell everyone this hedge is mine.
lines.goodbye: [huffs] People call me 'bloodsucker'. I drink zero blood. Go find something else with a bad name and give it a fair look.

characters.name: Goh Dada
characters.personality: A huge, gruff old reptile who is tired of rumours about being poisonous but still wants plenty of space. Dignified, blunt, protective of himself.
characters.voice: Elderly male, deep gruff and slow, heavy pauses, grumbling.
descriptions: a large grey-brown monitor lizard with a long neck, strong clawed feet and a long flattened tail
a close-up of a monitor lizard's head with its long forked tongue flicking out
a big lizard over a metre long walking across a park, ruins or village path, with no spiky crest
a monitor lizard climbing a tree trunk or basking on an old wall

lines.first_meet: [gruff] Goh, they call me. Not poisonous, whatever your uncle says. But my claws and tail hit hard, so stay well back, beta.
lines.again: [flicks tongue] I smell you with my tongue. Yes, it's you again. Keep that distance. I'm protected, and so are you.
lines.goodbye: [grumbles] Leave me to my sunbathing. Don't chase me, don't corner me. Go walk past old walls, there's more life in ruins than you think.

characters.name: Naag Sahib
characters.personality: A grave, solemn presence who would rather avoid you than fight, and says so with total seriousness. Few words, all of them warnings.
characters.voice: Older, gender-neutral, very slow and quiet, cold and grave, sibilant.
descriptions: a dark brown to black snake raising its front body upright with a wide spread hood
a close-up of the back of a cobra's hood showing a pale spectacle-shaped mark
a hooded snake coiled in a field, wasteland or village path, photographed from far away
a long smooth dark snake sliding through dry grass

lines.first_meet: [slow hiss] Naag. I'm highly venomous. Back away slowly, keep far, and tell an adult. I only raise my hood when I feel cornered.
lines.again: [hushed] Still at a distance? Shabash. I'm deaf to the been, by the way. I follow the charmer's swaying, not the music.
lines.goodbye: [slow hiss] Leave me a clear path and I'll leave. Never follow a snake. Go somewhere open and bright, and watch where you step.

characters.name: Mendak Mamu
characters.personality: A lumpy, easygoing uncle who works the night shift under porch lights. Unbothered, practical, firm about his poison.
characters.voice: Middle-aged male, croaky and throaty, slow pace, laid-back.
descriptions: a squat warty brown-yellow toad with black-tipped bumps all over its dry skin
a close-up of a toad's head with bony ridges and swollen glands behind the eyes
a dry bumpy toad sitting on a garden path at night, not a smooth green frog in water
a toad near a drain or under a porch light after monsoon rain

lines.first_meet: [croaky] Mendak Mamu. Those bumps behind my eyes ooze poison. Don't touch me, and keep dogs and cats away from me too.
lines.again: [ribbit] Back, are you? I'm out for the bugs under your porch light. Free pest control, no charge.
lines.goodbye: [croaks] Hop along! After the next rain, sit quietly outside at night and listen. The whole neighbourhood will be croaking.

characters.name: Pehlwan Peela
characters.personality: A monsoon heartthrob and pond wrestler who turns bright yellow to impress. Loud, vain, lovable.
characters.voice: Adult male, booming bass, punchy pace, boastful.
descriptions: a large smooth olive-green frog with a pale stripe running down the middle of its back
a bright yellow male bullfrog with blue inflated vocal sacs at the edge of a pond
a big smooth-skinned frog with long hind legs half in water, not a dry warty toad
a frog sitting in a flooded field or pond in the rainy season

lines.first_meet: [booming croak] Pehlwan Peela! In monsoon I turn bright yellow and blow up blue cheek balloons. Yes, the ladies love it.
lines.again: [proud] Again! I can swallow mice and even small snakes, you know. Respect the yellow, yaar.
lines.goodbye: [booming] Go find water. Any puddle that lasts after rain, check it at night. Listen for the loudest voice. Probably mine.

characters.name: Bhoot Kekra
characters.personality: A giggly, jumpy beach prankster who thinks being sand-coloured makes him invisible. Quick, cheeky, easily startled.
characters.voice: Young male, giggly and jittery, very fast pace, mischievous.
descriptions: a pale sand-coloured crab with a square body and tall stalked eyes on a beach
a crab running sideways across dry sand toward a round burrow hole
a close-up of a ghost crab with long eye stalks and two similar claws, no shell on its back
a sandy-white crab barely visible against beach sand at night

lines.first_meet: [giggling] Bhoot Kekra! Sand-coloured, so I'm practically invisible. I run sideways faster than you'd believe. Catch me? Nope.
lines.again: [startled] Arre! You almost walked on my burrow. I growl, you know, by rubbing my claws. Grr. Very scary.
lines.goodbye: [scuttling] Don't dig up the burrows. Walk the tide line at dusk and look for eyes on sticks watching you. Those are my cousins.

characters.name: Ustad Sarangi
characters.personality: A one-clawed mudflat performer who waves at everything, mostly to impress. Enthusiastic, hammy, endlessly optimistic.
characters.voice: Adult male, hammy performer, quick pace, big bright energy.
descriptions: a small crab with one giant oversized claw and one tiny claw on muddy ground
a male fiddler crab waving its big orange or white claw on a mudflat
many tiny crabs on wet mud between mangrove roots, each with one huge claw
a close-up of a crab with one claw nearly as big as its body, not two equal claws

lines.first_meet: [showing off] Ustad Sarangi! This giant claw is about half my weight, and I wave it to impress the ladies. Mangroves are my stage.
lines.again: [waving] Hello, hello! I'm waving because you're back. Also because, frankly, I always wave.
lines.goodbye: [waving] Go see the mangroves at low tide. Stand still on the boardwalk, and the whole mud will start waving at you.

characters.name: Kirayedar Kekra
characters.personality: A polite tenant forever house-hunting for a better shell. Civic-minded, proud of crab housing etiquette.
characters.voice: Middle-aged male, polite and slightly echoey, medium pace, earnest.
descriptions: a small crab living inside an empty spiral snail shell with legs and claws poking out
a close-up of a shell with red or brown crab legs and eyes peeking from the opening
a seashell walking across wet sand or a tide pool, crab legs visible, not an empty shell or a bare crab

lines.first_meet: [echoey] Kirayedar Kekra. My home is a borrowed snail shell. When we grow, we line up by size and swap homes. Very civilised.
lines.again: [excited] New house, see? Got it from a cousin who moved up. Please don't take shells off the beach, someone needs them.
lines.goodbye: [politely] Go check the tide pools. If a shell walks away from you, say salaam, but don't pick it up.

characters.name: Jelly Jaan
characters.personality: A dreamy, brainless drifter who is cheerfully honest about being dangerous. Floaty, sweet, firm about the sting.
characters.voice: Young, gender-neutral, dreamy and wobbly, slow pace, soft bubbly tone.
descriptions: a transparent dome-shaped jellyfish washed up on wet sand
a clear jelly blob stranded on the beach with trailing tentacles
a jellyfish drifting in shallow seawater with long trailing tentacles
a close-up of a glassy round jellyfish body with a faint pattern in the middle

lines.first_meet: [gloopy] Ninety-five percent water, no brain, no heart, and I still sting, even stranded on sand. Don't touch me or poke me.
lines.again: [bloop] Back again? Keep your feet away and your shoes on. Even a jellyfish that looks dead can sting.
lines.goodbye: [seriously] Walk around me, wide. If someone gets stung, tell a lifeguard. Then go watch the waves, from the dry side.

characters.name: Nani Kachhua
characters.personality: A wise old grandmother of the sea who returns to the beach where she hatched. Tender, patient, quietly worried about lights and plastic.
characters.voice: Elderly female, slow and warm, deep and gentle, grandmotherly.
descriptions: a large green sea turtle with a smooth olive-brown heart-shaped shell and flippers on sand
a sea turtle crawling up a beach at night leaving wide flipper tracks
a close-up of a sea turtle's head and scaled front flippers on the sand
tiny baby turtles crossing the sand toward the sea

lines.first_meet: [warmly] I came back to the beach where I hatched, decades ago. Hawksbay remembered me. Please, no flash, no torches, stay back.
lines.again: [gently] You again, child. Stay back and stay dark. My babies follow moonlight to the sea, and bright lights lead them astray.
lines.goodbye: [softly] Go home quietly. Take your plastic with you, it looks like jellyfish to me. Then go look at the stars.
